 This application coming on for admission this day, the 
 following:
 Order

This is the first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.456/2021 dated 24.05.2021, registered at P.S.-
Kotwali, District Seoni (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 465, 467, 468, 471,
120- B and 34 of IPC.

Applicant is in detention since 08.08.2023.
2 .

As per the prosecution story, three fictitious cheques were produced by Aatif Ansari, Moin Khan and Rajendra Singh Thakur before the bank and they withdrew an amount of Rs.1,79,63,000/- from Canara Bank Branch Seoni.
Applicant has been implicated in the alleged offence on the basis of memorandum of co-accused persons recorded under Section 27 of the Evidence Act.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant is not named in the FIR and no cheques were produced by him before the bank, even the money withdrawn was not transferred into his account.
There is no allegation against him about withdrawal of the money or receiving of the money from the main accused persons.
The memorandum of co-accused persons under Section 27 of the Evidence Act is neither legal nor admissible.
There is no other evidence available on record to connect the applicant with the prosecution story.
The applicant is in custody for the last more than two months.
Charge-sheet has already been filed.
Trial of the case will take considerable time.
Therefore, it is prayed that the applicant who is permanent resident of Waraseoni, District Balaghat may be released on bail.
4. On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has vehemently opposed grant of bail to the applicant.

5. Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case but without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this Court is of the view that it is a case in which further pre trial detention of the applicant is not required as trial of the case will take considerable time.
Consequently, this bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

6. It is directed that applicant - Jitesh Bamnote b e released on bail subject to furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
7.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case o f bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.

(DINESH KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE ak Jitesh Bamnote vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 18 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/9149069/
